description: List a monitor's past checks (newest first): timestamps, status, alerted flag, percent difference, errors. Use get_check for the full detail of one check. pageAccess says what the browser reached; when reachedContent is false the check saw a challenge, login or error page, so report that, not a change in content. To show one change to the user, open it once with get_check. When you link to a check, use its checkUrl (its comparison in monity.ai), never the raw screenshot, diff or HTML file URLs.

detail.description: Each check in full, with its evidence links, as get_check returns it. Used by the Monity view; leave unset for a summary.

includeHidden.description: Include changes the user hid (hide_change). Default false.

status.description: Filter by status: ALERT_SENT, CHANGE, NO_CHANGE, or ERROR

taskPanel.description: List what the Monity task panel lists: no skipped checks, failed checks only when the monitor alerts on errors. Used by the Monity view.

name: get_check_history
title: Get check history
